source.nonGameplay: Opening/countdown and closing victory/replay-menu footage are excluded from placement pages.

validation.method: Assisted frame-to-board reconstruction with temporal inspection; active/ghost/later-piece and scene-overlay exclusions are not locked cells.
limitations: Evidence timestamps are observation times, not exact lock/input times.
Hold/queue identities, movement inputs, kick paths and scoring classification are not encoded.
Canonical Fumen rotations may differ from equivalent symmetric input orientations.
Video rules and orientation differ from the current ST lab; this is reference data, not an STCore advice oracle.
The final victory banner is above the visible settled board; source video/media license rights are not asserted.
